purpose.reader_question: Why can separately uncertain task totals determine the combined labour exactly?
purpose.expected_reading: The marginal square contains jointly impossible pairs; enforcing capacity in both hours leaves a diagonal whose sum is always one person-hour.
purpose.claim: For this constructed saturated one-person example, adding separate bounds gives [0,2] first-hour person-hours, while joint constraints give exactly one.
purpose.scope: One person, two tasks each totaling one person-hour over [0,2] hours, target [0,1], measurable fractional allocations allowed.
permitted_inferences: Membership in the specified sets of first-hour totals.
Shared capacity can improve combined labour bounds without additional observations.
prohibited_inferences: A measured workplace result or causal effect of AI.
A probability distribution or statistical confidence interval.
Shared capacity always point-identifies aggregate labour.
A plotted pair specifies a complete time-allocation history.

inputs.source_reference: Constructed two-task example in Section 4.1 of article/partial-identification.tex; manuscript baseline 0cde2de1a79d54a0b1c557d8ba986375f9b283c9.
Exact rational calculation and independent allocation reconstruction in calculate.py; deterministic derived sets, no empirical measurements.
Proposed caption states the constructed inputs, quantities, deterministic feasible sets and scope.
Accessible description of the two plotted projections and their limitations.

quantities.transformation: Integrate each task allocation in the first hour; sum for combined labour. Values and endpoints are derived with rational arithmetic.

constructions.definition: 0 <= x <= 1 and 0 <= y <= 1, all boundaries included. This is the Cartesian product of separately calculated task bounds, not the joint feasible set.
constructions.method: Apply the one-person interval bound separately to each task total.

constructions.definition: The square intersected with x+y <= 1 and (1-x)+(1-y) <= 1; equivalently x+y=1. Closed endpoints (0,1),(1,0).
constructions.method: First-hour capacity supplies the upper half-plane; second-hour remaining labour supplies the lower half-plane. Construct piecewise-constant feasible allocations for every point of the line.

constructions.definition: Map (x,y) to x+y: the square projects onto [0,2] and the joint line onto {1}. These are deterministic images of sets of interval totals.
constructions.method: Linear projection; rational endpoints from calculate.py.
